Substations Technical Procedure
 Equipment Document No: T-024-r0
 Three Winding Transformers Test
 Megger 5000 V
 Procedure:
 Testing Procedure(s)
Introduction
This document lists the equipment testing procedure checklist, which must be performed for power
transformers according to each manufacturer Instructions.
Safety Precautions
 • Isolate the transformer from service and earthed,
 • A work order permit must be issued,
 • The qualified test staff should carry the suitable safety category,
 • Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
 • Disassemble HV and LV leads of the TR,
 • All bushing should be cleaned otherwise errors reading could be occurred,
 • Don�t touch test leads during test be careful of applied voltage 5kv DC.
Tools and Equipment
 • Test equipment type BM11 D, The company address:
 AVO - International, 4651 Single Westmorland TX 75237 - 1017 USA
Work to be Carried Out
For all tests make short circuit onto the 3 bushings of HV side and LV side be sure that the bushing
connections are well cleaned before you apply the meager test cables.
Test # 1 HV------> LV1 + LV2 + E
 1. Connect the S.C LV bushing with the S.C TER bushing with the earth point of the TR �E�
 2. Apply the +ve probe of megger to the S.C HV bushing. Apply the -ve probe of megger to the
 S.C LV bushing
 3. Turn on megger and record the reading after 15 sec. (R15) and record anther reading after 60
 sec. (R60)
 4. Turn off megger and calculate the ratio (R60 / R15)

Test # 2 LV1 ------> HV + LV2 + E
 1. Connect the S.C HV bushing with the earth point �E� of the TR with S.C TER bushing.
 2. Apply the + VE probe of megger to the S.C LV bushing. Apply the - VE probe of megger to
 the a S.C HV bushing.
 3. Turn on megger and record the reading after 15 sec. (R15) and record anther reading
 after 60 sec. (R60)
 4. Turn off megger and calculate the ratio (R60 / R15)
Test # 3 LV2 ------> HV + LV1 + E
 1. Connect the S.C HV bushing with S.C LV bushing to the point of the earth of the TR.
 2. Apply the +ve probe of megger to the SH.C. Ter V bushing and apply the -ve probe of
 megger to the earth point �E�.
 3. Turn on megger and record the reading after 15 sec. (R15) and record anther reading after 60
 sec. (R60)
 4. Turn off megger and calculate the ratio (R60 / R15)
Test # 4 HV + LV1 + LV2 ------> E
 5. Connect the S.C H V bushing with S.C LV bushing with S.C Ter bushing
 6. Apply the +ve probe of megger to S.C HV bushing and apply the -ve probe of megger to the
 earth point of the TR
 7. Turn on megger and record the reading after 15 sec ( R15 and anather reading after 60 sec
 R60 )
 8. Turn off megger and calculate the ratio R60/R15.
Test # 5 HV ------> LV1
 1. Remove any earth
 2. Apply the +ve probe of megger to the S.C HV bushing.
 3. Apply the -ve probe of megger to the S.C LV1 bushing.
 4. Turn on megger and record the reading after 15 sec. (R15) and record anther reading after 60
 second (R60)
 5. Turn off megger and calculate the ratio (R60 / R15)
Test # 6 HV ------> LV2
 1. Remove any earth
 2. Apply the +ve probe of megger to the S.C HV bushing.
 3. Apply the -ve probe of megger to the S.C LV2 bushing.
 4. Turn on megger and record the reading after 15 sec. (R15) and record anther reading after 60
 second (R60)
 5. Turn off megger and calculate the ratio (R60 / R15)

Test # 7 LV1 ------> LV2
 1. Remove any earth
 2. Apply the +ve probe of megger to the S.C LV1 bushing.
 3. Apply the -ve probe of megger to the S.C LV2 bushing.
 4. Turn on megger and record the reading after 15 sec. (R15) and record anther reading after 60
 second (R60)
 5. Turn off megger and calculate the ratio (R60 / R15)
